turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: For Barcelona, there's a tiny hotel in the old town or a bigger place outside the center with a pool. Same price.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The old town puts you right in the action, but it can be noisy at night. The pool is great in summer, but you'd take the metro in. What matters more to you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you wait? My friend is talking to me. Keep quiet until I come back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I had the weirdest dream. You were a waiter and you kept serving me soup made of buttons.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Buttons? Was it good at least?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It was crunchy. Then my teeth started falling out.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oh, the teeth one. I get that before exams.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you think it means something?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It means you ate cheese at midnight. I saw you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. The Barcelona hotel. Center or pool?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good point. Just check how close it is to a metro stop, ideally under ten minutes' walk.
